requests.title: BFS - 미로 탈출 최단 경로
requests.description: BFS로 0/1 격자 미로에서 출발점(0,0)부터 목적지(n-1,m-1)까지 최단 거리를 구하는 코드의 빈칸 5개를 채우세요.

codes.codeTemplate:
```python

from collections import deque

maze = [[1,0,1,1],[1,1,0,1],[0,1,1,1]]

n, m = len(maze), len(maze[0])

dist = [[-1]*m for _ in range(n)]

q = deque([(0,0)]); dist[0][0]=_____

for dx,dy in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:

    pass

q = deque([(0,0)])

dist[0][0] = 0

while _____:

    x,y = q.popleft()

    for dx,dy in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:

        nx,ny = x+dx, y+dy

        if 0<=nx<n and 0<=ny<m and maze[nx][ny] and dist[nx][ny]==-1:

            dist[nx][ny] = dist[_____][y]+1

            q.append((nx,ny))

print(dist[_____][_____])

```
